answer_1.quote: We prompted each LLM to generate an argument for why the sentences in the sample set are sexist or non-sexist.
answer_1.outputs: Arguments defending or criticizing implicit sexist sentences based on moral foundations

answer_2.quote: We prompted GPT-4 to rate the quality of the generated explanations on a scale of 0-100.

answer_3.quote: We used GPT-4 to evaluate the generation quality of the full EDOS-sup dataset for the two metrics, comprehensibility and relevancy to context.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation: We randomly sampled 3.5% of the EDOS-sup comments and manually evaluated the quality of arguments that defend or criticize the implicit sexist comments generated by eight LLMs, thus evaluating 600 pairs.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators were asked to choose among very, somewhat, and not at all, depending on the extent to which the generated text meets the requirements and definitions of the three properties.
